ability.name: Charge Wand
ability.description: Charges an equipped wand or staff to fire neutral magic bolts on attack. Requires a wand equipped; no reagents.

ability.name: Discharge
ability.description: Releases any active charged spell (such as wand charges) without effect. No mana cost or reagents.

ability.name: Anti-Protect
ability.description: Toggles refusal of the betsanc protect spell, dispelling any current physical shield. No mana cost or reagents.

ability.name: Enchant Lifestone
ability.description: Creates 1 Lifestone. Requires 1 Insect Leg, or 1 Insect Slime, or 1 each of Mauve, Alizarin, Cobalt and Gamboge Herb.

ability.name: Detect Players
ability.description: Lists the names of other players nearby on the same map. No reagents.

ability.name: Detect Magic
ability.description: Reveals nearby magical beings: highlights magic npcs and magician players with a visual effect. No reagents.

ability.name: Sense Experience
ability.description: Tells you how well you control your magic, hinting at progress toward the next magic level. No reagents.

ability.name: Sense Spouse
ability.description: Tells you whether your spouse is currently online. Only works when married.

ability.name: Lesser Heal
ability.description: Heals the target (or self) by 200 HP. Requires 1 Lifestone.

ability.name: Lay On Hands
ability.description: Heals another player fully by sacrificing part of the caster's own HP. No item reagents; pays with caster HP.

ability.name: Flare Dart
ability.description: Imbues attacks with fire damage for several charges. Requires 1 Sulphur Powder; waived at war magic level 3+.

ability.name: Magic Blade
ability.description: Turns attacks into magic melee strikes. Requires 1 Sharp Knife or 1 Knife; waived at war magic level 3+.

ability.name: Arrow Hail
ability.description: Summons a hail of arrows striking an area ahead of the caster. Requires 20 Arrows or 20 Iron Arrows plus 1 Sulphur Powder.

ability.name: Lightning Strike
ability.description: Charges attacks with lightning bolts. Requires 1 Iron Powder; waived at war magic level 4+.

ability.name: Magic Knuckles
ability.description: Empowers bare-handed attacks with fast magic punches. Requires 1 Beer; waived at war magic level 4+.

ability.name: Make Sulphur
ability.description: Transmutes ash into Sulphur Powder; yield scales with spellpower. Requires 1 Pile of Ash.

ability.name: Transmute Wood
ability.description: Transmutes a Raw Log into a Mouboo Figurine, though the magic often fails and produces a Warped Log.

ability.name: Make Arrows
ability.description: Transmutes a Raw Log into Iron Arrows; amount scales with spellpower. Requires 1 Raw Log.

ability.name: Make Bones
ability.description: Transmutes bones into Bone Arrows; amount scales with spellpower. Requires 1 Animal Bones or 1 Bone.

ability.name: Make Iron Powder
ability.description: Transmutes ore into Iron Powder; yield scales with spellpower. Requires 1 Iron Ore.

ability.name: Make Shirt
ability.description: Transmutes cloth into a Cotton Shirt. Requires 5 Cotton Cloth.

ability.name: Make Tanktop
ability.description: Transmutes cloth into a Tank Top. Requires 4 Cotton Cloth.

ability.name: Make Short Tanktop
ability.description: Transmutes cloth into a Short Tank Top. Requires 3 Cotton Cloth.

ability.name: Aggravate
ability.description: Draws the attention of nearby monsters to the caster (radius grows with spellpower). No reagents.

ability.name: Grow Mauve
ability.description: Summons Mauve Plants near the caster. Requires 1 Mauve Herb and 1 Root.

ability.name: Grow Alizarin
ability.description: Summons Alizarin Plants near the caster. Requires 1 Alizarin Herb and 1 Root.

ability.name: Grow Cobalt
ability.description: Summons Cobalt Plants near the caster. Requires 1 Cobalt Herb and 1 Root.

ability.name: Grow Gamboge
ability.description: Summons Gamboge Plants near the caster. Requires 1 Gamboge Herb and 1 Root.

ability.name: Grow Shadow
ability.description: Summons Shadow Plants near the caster. Requires 1 Shadow Herb and 1 Root.

ability.name: Flying Backpack
ability.description: Levitates the target's backpack (SC_FLYING_BACKPACK) for a spellpower-scaled duration. Requires 1 Silk Cocoon; waived at school level 4+.

ability.name: Happy Curse
ability.description: Makes players around the caster repeatedly show happy emotes. Requires 1 Gingerbread Man; waived at school level 4+.

ability.name: Protect
ability.description: Grants the target a physical shield (SC_PHYS_SHIELD) scaling with spellpower. Requires 1 Hard Spike; waived at school level 4+.

ability.name: Rain
ability.description: Summons a wandering rain cloud that soaks the area and injures fire-element beings. Requires 1 Bottle Of Water; waived at school level 4+.

ability.name: Shear
ability.description: Overrides your attack to shear a monster, making it drop fur, herbs, spikes, cocoons or antennae. No reagents.

ability.name: Summon Maggots
ability.description: Summons maggots that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Insect Slime and 1 Root.

ability.name: Summon Fluffies
ability.description: Summons fluffies that fight for the caster. Requires 1 White Fur and 1 Root.

ability.name: Summon Mouboo
ability.description: Summons mouboos that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Mouboo Figurine and 1 Root.

ability.name: Summon Pinkie
ability.description: Summons pinkies that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Pink Antenna and 1 Root.

ability.name: Summon Spiky Mushroom
ability.description: Summons spiky mushrooms that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Hard Spike and 1 Root.

ability.name: Barrier
ability.description: Surrounds the target (or self) with a magical barrier that absorbs damage. Requires 1 Small Mushroom; waived at astral magic level 4+.

ability.name: Hide
ability.description: Turns the target (or self) invisible for a while. Requires 1 Cotton Cloth; waived at astral magic level 4+.

ability.name: Summon Snakes
ability.description: Summons 1+ random snakes (Cave/Mountain/Grass/normal) that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Dark Crystal and 1 Snake Egg.

ability.name: Summon Wicked Mushroom
ability.description: Summons mushrooms (60% Wicked, 30% Moonshroom, 10% Evil) that fight for the caster. Requires 1 Dark Crystal and 1 Small Mushroom.

ability.name: Toxic Dart
ability.description: Charges attacks with neutral/poison damage that also poisons player targets. Requires 2 Roots, waived at Dark level 3+.

ability.name: Necromancy
ability.description: Revives a dead player after 6 seconds, leaving both caster and target at 1 HP and 0 SP. Requires 1 Soul.
